title: Signal Dunes · storm shells to a shader graph
subtitle: The Matriarch's phase II sand storm: two blown-sand shells round the player (46 m coarse, 22 m fine), ShaderMaterial GLSL vs two SF59 unlit graphs whose alpha rides the storm's strength (G397 / G387). iPhone 16 Pro portrait, phone tier, storm held at full (0.99), same poses.
notes: Same streaks racing downwind, same density toward the horizon and ground, same gust pulse, same colour and shares (0.85 / 0.4); the streak noise is the old value noise.
The dusty veil now uses the graph's gradient noise (a different field, same strength); the graph runs on the renderer's clock, so the streaks sit in other places.
AFTER reads a touch darker and redder in the veil (mean green/blue down ~4 of 255; 0-2 % of pixels move by more than 16).
